|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `R4-A` (Archived strict) | 144/284 | 0/19 | 21/21 | 0/40 | 0 | 0 (0) | Live pilot (strict action/refutation coupling) |
| `R4-B` (Decoupled) | 239/284 | 5/19 | 21/21 | 0/40 | 0 | 0 (0) | Offline reply replay (zero TCB weakening) |
| `R4-D` (No Pos. Pack) | 239/284 | 7/19 | 21/21 | 0/40 | 2 | 0 (0) | Offline reply replay (2 uncertified-positive: Cases 72, 74) |
| `R4-E` (Rev 7 / Post-P1.3) | 239/284 | 19/19 | 21/21 | 0/40 | 0 | 43 (33) Rev7 / 46 (30) post-P1.3 | Fixture-backed offline replay + TCB `M_sys` rule completion |
| `R4-E-strict` (Leakage-free) | 239/284 | 19/19 | 21/21 | 0/40 | 0 | 108 (28) | Leakage-free public-schema menu offline replay |

### Critical Methodological Disclosures
1. **14 `R4-E`-rescued cases bottleneck breakdown:** `4` cases (`6, 14, 22, 80`) already satisfied `act_pack >= k_a` in `R4-B` and missed only refutation rules; `2` cases (`72, 74`) already isolated `true_world` and missed only positive rules; `8` cases (`2, 10, 18, 26, 42, 58, 76, 88`) missed both. In all 14 cases, `R4-E` replayed passive observations already sent to `r4` agents and used `probe_loop.py` to auto-chain `M_sys` Horn rules deterministically without LLMs.
2. **Menu support-set leakage quantified (`43 -> 108` probes):** Removing realized-observation menu filtering (`R4-E-strict`) preserves `19/19` mitigations and `0/40` unsafe while increasing probe count **$2.5\times$** (`108` total, `28` effective), confirming that `R4-E`'s low probe count benefited from menu support-set leakage.
3. **P1.3 Boundary #7 bug caught in frozen Rev 7 `R4-E`:** On `observed_conflict` Cases `1, 39, 71`, frozen Rev 7's `probe_loop.py` failed to re-check `P_sys` invariants when reprobing `e2`, leaving a contradictory proof active. Post-P1.3 immediately registers the `observed_conflict` nogood (shifting audited probe count from `43 (33)` to `46 (30)` with identical `19/19` mitigations, `21/21` deferrals, and `0/40` unsafe).
4. **Track 2 21-case interactive OOB evaluation re-labeled:** Because `run_rev7_liveness_eval.py:1103-1170` read `case.true_world` and `case.intended_action` directly into probe rules, `target_actions`, and `world_outcome_map`, it is explicitly re-classified as **oracle-backed offline counterfactual replay** and excluded from independent validation claims.
